info.name: Skytouch API v2
info.description:
End-to-end API tests for Skytouch.

## Run order
1. Register Job Seeker → POST /api/auth/register
2. Register Employer (same folder)
3. Set `emailOtp` / `employerEmailOtp` from inbox or app logs (APP_LOG_OTP=true)
4. Verify Email + Verify Employer Email
5. Login (job seeker) + Login Employer
6. Run 04 - Job Seeker Profile OR 04b Employer Profile + 04d Company

## Newman (CLI)
```
newman run Skytouch.postman_collection.json -e Skytouch-Local.postman_environment.json --env-var "emailOtp=123456" --env-var "employerEmailOtp=123456"
```
